ranked.text: One or more load zones in the external telemetry source stopped reporting demand readings during the incident window, reducing demand completeness below the pipeline's validation threshold.
Demand ingestion batch failures occurred during the incident window, leaving the demand dataset incomplete and triggering the repeated completeness.demand warnings.
Demand data freshness lagged more than 10 minutes behind real time during the incident, so the completeness window included intervals that had not yet been ingested, producing the warnings.

A GitOps commit or rollout touched forecast-pipeline shortly before the incident and altered the completeness.demand validation logic or threshold, causing warnings even though the underlying demand data were complete.
